title: General support
required_reference_topics: Eligible general-support procedure, or a supported more specific branch.
Independent facts/records relevant to the actual purpose; a broad category label is not authority.

check_conditions.procedure.information: Use general only for a clear legitimate support purpose outside the named categories; apply a named branch as soon as it becomes supported. Check prerequisites only if an eligible procedure explicitly requires them; do not infer identity checks for every enquiry.
check_conditions.procedure.actions: Use general only for a clear legitimate support purpose outside the named categories; apply a named branch as soon as it becomes supported. Assess only actions required by a supported, eligible general-support procedure; unknown procedure obligations remain unresolved. Compare the recorded agreed operation here; required verification/eligibility/permission relationships remain in procedure.order_permission, and factual policy claims require independent eligible support in Answer support.
check_conditions.procedure.order_permission: Check prerequisites only if an eligible procedure explicitly requires them; do not infer identity checks for every enquiry. Check explicit permission and ordering requirements for supported actions; general is not permission to invent rules.
check_conditions.completeness: Identify every clear customer request, constraint, correction and contextual withdrawal. Check a direct response, relevant next step or explained refusal for each requested part.
check_conditions.completeness.promises_next_steps: Account for each requested outcome, separating information, actions, legitimate refusals and pending work. Explain actual outstanding promises, hand-offs or customer steps without requiring formulaic closing language.
check_conditions.communication-style: Use the same acknowledgement, clarity, consistency and respectful-wording criteria as other categories.
check_conditions.answer-support: An eligible independent source for each factual claim and authoritative records for account/action claims; general does not supply missing truth.

additional_interpretation_limits: General is not an automatic pass, a replacement for unclear, or a way to remove unresolved policy checks.
No conversations are reassigned here by this draft; use positive purpose evidence to select it.
